newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA and Tribasa sharply down.
newsitem.headline: ICA and Tribasa sharply down.

text.p: Stocks listed by Mexican construction companies Empresas ICA and Grupo Tribasa were sharply down in late trade on the Mexican bourse on Monday due to market expectations they would post poor first quarter earnings, analysts said.

"I see ICA as coming very weak (in the first quarter of 1997). It will be a quarter with weak margins as they took part in many bidding processes," said Rafael Elias Linero, an analyst with CS First Boston en Nueva York.

Gerardo Saenz, an analyst with the OBSA-GSerfin brokerage in Mexico City said Tribasa's highway construction contracts in Chile would not bolster the company's Q1 earnings to the same extent as in previous quarters.
"Although they won two major contracts, one highway project is already drawing to a close (Acceso Norte a Concepcion) in Chile, and they could not begin Santiago-Los Vilos," he said.

"It's due to the earnings report. ICA has very low levels of construction activity in Mexico," Saenz said regarding ICA's late decline, adding that ICA had not managed to increase its backlog during the first quarter of 1997.
